field.value: Which model does this listing cover?
This listing covers BQ043 / 8008. Review the photographed product and current color-size options on this page; no other model is included.
What is the current minimum order quantity?
The current listing minimum is 2 pairs. Send quantities for each selected color-size option so availability and order terms can be confirmed.
What quantity prices are currently listed?

Current displayed unit prices: USD 9.49 from 2 pairs, USD 9.19 from 50 pairs, USD 9.09 from 100 pairs. Final quotation depends on confirmed quantities and specifications; unquoted freight and taxes are excluded.
How should I request colors, sizes and fit information?

Use the color-size options currently offered on this page and state quantities for each option. Request measurements for the selected source size; fit and international size conversion are confirmed before the order.
Can logo and packaging requirements be reviewed?
Send requested artwork, logo position and packaging specifications for review and quotation. Feasibility, sample requirements and charges are confirmed for the specific order.
How are availability, dispatch and shipping confirmed?

Send the destination, postal code, quantities and requested dispatch date. Availability, production or dispatch timing and freight are confirmed in the order quotation; this FAQ does not claim ready stock.
Can I ask for a sample before a bulk order?
Ask about sample availability and charges for BQ043 / 8008. Review the actual sample, measurements and fit requirements before confirming a bulk order.
How can I confirm specific materials or tested performance?

Refer to the current product attributes and provide your required material specification or test standard. Exact material grades, component compositions and any test evidence need order-specific confirmation; no additional certification or tested performance is promised.
